title: 205 unicorns overseas have an Indian-origin founder. Together, they're worth $560 billion.

sources.text: YourStory, September 2026 - Indian founders account for $560B unicorn valuation overseas: report
Business Standard, September 2026 - 205 unicorns abroad, 102 in India: The $560-billion Indian founder story

caption:
205 unicorns overseas have an Indian-origin founder. Together, they're worth $560 billion.

The index tracks 205 current and former unicorns outside India with at least one founder who grew up in India - attributing $560 billion of founder-share value to them. Of those 205 companies, 91% are based in the United States.

70 of those overseas unicorns were built entirely by all-Indian founding teams, worth $243 billion combined - names like Jay Chaudhry (Zscaler) and the founding teams behind Rubrik and Nutanix. For comparison, India's own 102 home-grown unicorns - led by Flipkart, Zomato and Groww - are worth roughly $349 billion on the same basis.

A Viksit Bharat by 2047 doesn't need every builder to stay home - it needs the value they create abroad to keep flowing back through investment, mentorship and eventually, homecoming. $560 billion is proof of exactly how much capacity is out there to draw on.
